cases.sql: SELECT c.name AS 渠道名称, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 本期GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN o.id END) AS 本期订单数, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN o.id END), 0), 2) AS 本期客单价, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 上期GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN o.id END) AS 上期订单数, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN o.id END), 0), 2) AS 上期客单价, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 1) AS GMV环比增长率 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN safe.channels AS c ON c.id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND ((o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01') OR (o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02')) GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 本期GMV DESC LIMIT 500

cases.sql: SELECT p.id AS 商品ID, p.name AS 商品名称, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 本期退款金额, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN r.id END) AS 本期退款笔数, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 上期退款金额, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01' THEN r.id END) AS 上期退款笔数, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 退款金额增长 FROM safe.refunds AS r JOIN safe.orders AS o ON r.order_id = o.id JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN safe.products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND ((r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01') OR (r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01')) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 退款金额增长 DESC LIMIT 15

cases.sql: SELECT o.province AS 收货省份, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 本期包裹量, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 上期包裹量, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.paid_at, s.delivered_at) END), 1) AS 本期平均发货时效小时, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.paid_at, s.delivered_at) END), 1) AS 上期平均发货时效小时, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.paid_at, s.delivered_at) END) - AVG(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.paid_at, s.delivered_at) END), 1) AS 时效变化小时 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.shipments AS s ON s.order_id = o.id WHERE NOT s.delivered_at IS NULL AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY o.province HAVING 本期包裹量 > 0 ORDER BY 时效变化小时 DESC LIMIT 500
